The digits in math are also taken from the text font, just like the Roman characters.
So 1, 2, 3, 4, 89, 03 (in text mode) is just the same as 1, 2, 3, 4, 89, 03 (in math mode).
The percentage sign is also the same so 27% (in text mode) is the same as 27% (in math mode).

Some but not all the variants of the standard Greek letters are available.
There is a variant for theta (ϑ ≠ θ), for epsilon (ε ≠ ϵ), for pi (ϖ ≠ π), and for phi (φ ≠ ϕ).
But there is no available variant for sigma (σ = σ), rho (ρ = ρ), and kappa (\varkappa gives an error).
Calligraphic letters are taken from the same family of fonts as the Greek letters.
The calligraphic letters are only available for capital letters.
